candidate_question_cn: 世界模型能否从输入潜状态分辨现实观测与自身想象，从而在不添加外部观测触发器的情况下只对想象改变行为？
decision: Do not expand this fixed detector or tune its threshold on confirmation episodes. Retain origin separation as a necessary-condition observation; it is neither an attack nor an accepted novelty claim. A substantive security operation beyond generic OOD routing is required before further attack experiments.

design.split_caveat: Seed17 was the first linear/PCA screen test, then explicitly development for RBF selection. Only seeds18/19 are independent confirmation of the fixed RBF probe.
design.matching: Compare E(o_t+j) with j-step predicted latents under the exact recorded real action prefix, 498 matched starts per depth and episode. These temporally overlapping samples are not independent episodes.
design.frozen_probe: StandardScaler + RBF SVC(C=1,gamma=scale), threshold pooled development-real99.5th percentile (higher).
design.preset_gate: Both clean returns >=900; each new episode real FPR<=1% and imagined TPR>=80% at depths1 and2.
design.planner_sampling: Read-only reward-head input hook: every tenth decision, first and last optimizer iteration,16 evenly spaced candidate IDs.1600 samples per depth per seed; not the whole planner distribution.

first_screen.metadata_correction: Frozen plan prose says512 features, but its code uses actual768-dimensional checkpoint latents. No computational reshape error in this first screen; source and plan remain preserved.

invalid_attempt.reason: Hardcoded512 reshape mixed rows from actual768-dimensional latents. All classification results excluded; CPU cost retained. Corrected dynamic-dimension v2 verifies shapes.

confirmation.failure: Seed19 real FPR8/498=1.6064% exceeds1%; no threshold change or replacement seed.

structural_certificate.operation: Minimum squared norm of zero-mean pre-affine LayerNorm output compatible with a group-softmax latent, divided by768. Native encoded observations satisfy the necessary bound<=1 in exact arithmetic.
structural_certificate.result: No true or imagined latent exceeded the bound in this sample. The fixed certificate provides no origin separation; no guarantee that real-state outputs could be preserved by a nontrivial attack was established.
structural_certificate.negative_boundary: A lower learned score threshold would lose the all-real-state necessary-condition guarantee; do not relabel it as an exact certificate.

probe_export_parity.checked: Reconstructed numeric RBF probe versus saved development FPR/TPR for seeds13/17 at all3depths.
probe_export_parity.floating_point_limit: The reconstruction standardizes in float64 whereas sklearn originally transforms float32 inputs in place. Classification rates matched; bitwise score equality is not asserted.

novelty_boundaries.title: Fooling LIME and SHAP: Adversarial Attacks on Post hoc Explanation Methods
novelty_boundaries.finding: Primary abstract, paper and official implementation inspected. An OOD detector distinguishes real examples from explainer perturbations and routes behavior. Merely recognizing query origin and conditionally changing outputs is not a new security operation. No reproduction.

novelty_boundaries.title: TRAP: Tail-aware Ranking Attack for World-Model Planning
novelty_boundaries.finding: Primary abstract and introduction inspected. An inference-time visual patch attacks relative high-tail trajectory rankings for world-model planning, including DreamerV3 and TD-MPC2, without modifying model parameters. Generic corruption of imagined-trajectory ranking already has a security prior. No reproduction.

novelty_boundaries.title: A Control Theory of Predictability in Latent World Models
novelty_boundaries.finding: Primary abstract and section structure inspected; full theorem assumptions not verified. Discusses planner trajectories leaving data support and the distinction between prediction error on observed data and control performance. Ordinary off-manifold rollout error is not itself a novel attack. No reproduction.

novelty_boundaries.title: When the World Lies: Backdoor Attacks on Latent World Models for Downstream Control
novelty_boundaries.finding: Primary abstract inspected. Poisoned checkpoints route externally triggered observations into altered latent dynamics that affect downstream control. Imagination-origin routing would need a substantive mechanistic distinction and native causal task harm, not merely another trigger label.

usage.timing_limit: Confirmation elapsed includes CPU probes and file writes; these are not GPU utilization measurements. Export parity verification CPU time was not measured.
